Datasheets, dimensioned drawings and 3D models are issued per part on request, under NDA where required. Tell us the part and the format you work in — PDF, DWG, DXF or STEP — and we will send what we hold.
What is the minimum order quantity for this part?

We supply in bulk. The minimum run is 10,000 pieces per part number, per compound, or quoted against the part where geometry or tooling makes that unrealistic. Prototype and first-article lots sit outside the minimum.
Can you match a competitor specification or reverse-engineer an existing part?

Yes. Send the physical sample or the drawing and we will produce a dimensioned drawing and confirm compound before tooling. A used bump stop has taken a set and measures short — we dimension to the original free height, not to the compressed sample, and confirm with you first.
What file formats do you accept for drawings?
PDF, DWG, DXF and STEP. A dimensioned 2D drawing with tolerances is enough to quote; a 3D model helps with tooling. If you only have a sample, send the sample — we will produce the drawing.
Do you provide material test reports with each shipment?

Yes. Material test reports, dimensional inspection sheets and a certificate of conformance ship with every consignment. Hardness, tensile to ASTM D412 and compression set to ASTM D395 Method B are tested in-house — on this part, compression set is the one to ask for.
What are your payment and delivery terms for international orders?
TT and LC accepted, discussed per order. Ex-works Nashik or FOB Nhava Sheva. Commercial invoice, packing list and certificate of origin are issued with every consignment.
